responsibility: Holds the machine description for CRIS atomic and synchronization operations. It defines unspec codes, iterators, expanders, and instruction patterns for fetch-op and compare-and-swap sequences across QI/HI/SI modes, including memory-model fence insertion, alignment trapping or library fallback decisions, and the two target-specific implementation strategies: LL/SC-style retry loops for CRIS v10 and interrupt-masked critical sections for older CRIS cores.
